programme.title: Champion [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A former champ trains for an intense arm-wrestling tournament in South Korea, confronting his past along the way.

programme.title: Rebound [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In an emotional sports movie based on a true story, Yang Hyun, a former basketball player and public service worker, becomes the new coach of Busan Jungang High School's basketball team, which is in danger of disbanding. After a humiliating loss to a strong team in the national tournament, Yang Hyun recruits the players and tries to prevent the team from disbanding. As a result, a group of boys, some who don't even know what basketball is, some who have full of passion but no skill, and some who are on the verge of giving up their dreams due to slumps and injuries, come together to create a miraculous history at the 2012 National High School Basketball Championship.

programme.title: Victory [English Dub]
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story and a feel-great, rip-roaring romp about a group of high school girls who shake a sleepy town alive with pom-poms and perfectly synchronized cheerleading routines.

programme.title: The Wasted Times [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Set against a chaotic, war torn Shanghai, “The Wasted Times” follows a local crime boss at the receiving end of the Japanese army’s attempt to forge a dubious alliance.

programme.title: The Big Call [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ding Xiao Tian is a young policeman whose sole goal is to catch Lin A Hai, the leader of a ring that deals in phone scams, and have caused his high-school teacher to commit suicide after being bankrupted by them. Eventually, Ding finds himself a temporary member of the Anti-Telecommunication Fraud Centre in Donghai city, under the leadership of Tan Si Rong, who explains to him the actual size of Lin A Hai and his girlfriend’s, Liu Li Fang’s ring, which has spread to Hong Kong and Thailand, “succeeding” in hundreds of frauds, even including millionaires. At the same time, Ding Xiao Tian learns that an ex-classmate of his from the police academy, Xu Xiao Tu, has infiltrated the Thai headquarters of the ring, run by Liu Li Fang. The story then unfolds into three axes, one focused on the two police officers, the other on Xu Xiaotu and Liu Li Fang, and the last on Lin A Hai, who also experiences some struggles.

programme.title: Better Days [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A bullied teenage girl forms an unlikely friendship with a mysterious young man who protects her from her assailants, while she copes with the pressures of her final examinations.

programme.title: Resurrection of the Little Match Girl [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: To Chinese restaurant delivery boy 'Ju', the only joy in life is spending time at the electronic game room. One day, 'Ju' who was engrossed in an electronic game as usual, is advised to log-on to a game called <Resurrection of the Little Match Girl>.

programme.title: Triple Tap [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Champion competitive marksman Ken comes across an armored van robbery. He sees a policeman held hostage and shoots and kills four of the robbers. One of the robbers escapes and the policeman survives. The case is handled by Jerry Chang, whom Ken knows from having recently beaten him in a shooting match. Ken is found not guilty in court. Soon after, Ken is attacked by the escaped robber Pang Tao. Their confrontation reveals a very different background story and brings about a myriad of lies and traps and changes in relationships as Jerry and Ken try to outsmart each other.

programme.title: Kill-Fist [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A struggling middle-aged insurance salesman and failed family man joins an underground fight club to redeem himself. As he progresses through the fights, he finds his true potential and faces his dark past that he has forgotten.

programme.title: Miss Baek [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Sang-a, or Miss Baek, was convicted of a crime because she tried to defend herself. Now she doesn't believe in people, let alone love them. She is about to move to Jeju, and her "friend" Jang-seob, the detective for Sang-a's case, cannot hold her down. One day, Sang-a meets a small girl from her neighborhood. Her body gets covered with bruises; she wears a pajama on the bone-chilling winter night. The girl, Ji-eun, has been abused by his father, Il-gon, and his girlfriend, Mi-kyung, for a long time. As an abused and neglected child, Sang-a tries and fails to "save" her. When Ji-eun escapes her house after getting brutally beaten, Sang-a grabs her and runs away. Il-gon and Mi-kyung reported the abduction while finding Ji-eun to remove the evidence. To protect the girl, Sang-a steps up and fights against the abuser.

programme.title: A Taxi Driver [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: During the Gwangju Uprising, a Seoul taxi driver and a journalist join citizens' fight for freedom in 1980 South Korea.

programme.title: 26 Years [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: 26 years ago, state troops were ordered to open fire on civilians in city of Gwangju who were demonstrating as apart of a democratic movement.

programme.title: Dying to Survive [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Based on a real-life story, this audience-acclaimed dramedy tells the tale of Cheng Yong, a down-on-his-luck aphrodisiac salesman whose life changes forever when he's enlisted to help smuggle and sell a cheap but illegal cancer drug from India.

programme.title: Rampant [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Returning from imprisonment, a prince and his fellow countrymen band together to battle bloodthirsty demons.

programme.title: HELTER SKELTER [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Top star Lilico undergoes multiple cosmetic surgeries to her entire body. As her surgeries show side effect.

programme.title: SAKURAN [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A young girl is sold into a red-light district brothel and tries to adapt to life and meke her own way as an No.1 oiran (courtesan).

programme.title: The Time of Fever [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ho-tae and Dong-hui, childhood friends who grew up like brothers, reunite when Ho-tae returns to Gangneung for his father's funeral. Dong-hui, having been kicked out after coming out, now lives alone in Ho-tae's empty house. As they begin living together, Dong-hui struggles with his feelings for Ho-tae, his first love. Ho-tae, too, starts experiencing unfamiliar emotions. To cope, Ho-tae dates recklessly, which hurts Dong-hui. After an unexpected incident, their delicate relationship begins to change.
